notes.title: Demo Update #4
notes.notes:
- You can choose your character's voice along with your character. 

- In the settings, you can choose how many lives you have during the match. 

- Visual improvements to the HUD 

- A NEW VERSUS MODE WHERE YOU CAN HUMILIATE YOUR FRIENDS! (But it will be available in the full game.)



That's it.
